last_attempts_log.asr_text: But it's too soon to jump to, “Add a button to increase rewards and bring world peace.” The two were separate experiments. We can't say that the difference in choices alone caused the difference in results. We don't know that offering an increase option can prevent meanness. The experiment also dealt only with brief boredom and actions that reduced another person's reward. We can't apply its findings directly to everyday meanness or boredom that lasts a long time. Even so, our view of boring moments shifts a little. We can ask not only, “What mustn't I do?” but also, “What else can I do instead?” Before looking into someone's personality, look at the menu in front of us.
